recon.list.title: Recon
recon.list.subtitle: Authorized security scans for your projects.
recon.list.empty.title: No scans yet
recon.list.empty.body: Start a new authorized scan to see results here.
recon.actions.cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this scan?
recon.actions.cancelConfirm.body: The scan will stop and no further actions will run. Already-collected findings will remain available.
recon.actions.resumeConfirm.title: Resume this scan?
recon.actions.resumeConfirm.body: Re-confirm the target URL to prevent accidental target drift on resume.
recon.actions.resumeConfirm.urlMismatch: URL must match the original target exactly.
recon.wizard.title: New scan
recon.wizard.subtitle: Configure, authorize, and start an authorized security scan.
recon.wizard.step1.title: Choose the scan target
recon.wizard.step1.subtitle: Pick a project and an environment with a reachable target URL.
recon.wizard.step1.noProjects: No scannable projects. Connect a GitHub repository to a project first.
recon.wizard.step1.noEnvironments: No environments with a target URL. Add an environment with a URL first.
recon.wizard.step1.configHelp: Upload a YAML file to customise phases or scope. Max 64 KB.
recon.wizard.step1.productionWarning.bod: You are about to scan a production environment. We will not block this, but you must explicitly confirm authorization in the next step.
recon.wizard.step2.title: Authorize this scan
recon.wizard.step2.subtitle: You must confirm that you have permission to scan this target.
recon.wizard.step2.acknowledgementBody.r: The scanner will attempt real exploits against this target, not simulations.
recon.wizard.step2.acknowledgementBody.a: Your authorization, including this justification, is recorded in the immutable audit trail.
recon.wizard.step2.acknowledgementBody.l: You confirm that you have the legal authority to authorize this scan on this target.
recon.wizard.step2.justificationPlacehol: Why are you scanning this target? Include the ticket, change request, or owner.
recon.wizard.step2.justificationTooShort: Justification must be at least 20 characters.
recon.wizard.step3.title: Review and start
recon.wizard.step3.subtitle: Confirm the target and authorization before we start the scan.
recon.wizard.step3.incomplete: Target selection is incomplete. Go back and pick a project and environment.
recon.wizard.discard.title: Discard new scan?
recon.wizard.discard.body: Your selections on this wizard will be lost. This action cannot be undone.
recon.detail.findings.empty: No findings for this scan. Consider scheduling another scan later to re-check the target.
recon.detail.phases.title: Scan phases
recon.detail.phases.stuckBanner: This scan appears stuck. You can resume to pick up where it left off.
recon.detail.report.notReady: The report will appear once the scan completes.
recon.detail.raw.largeDownload.title: Download large artifact?
recon.detail.raw.largeDownload.body: This artifact is larger than 10 MB. The download may take a moment.
